section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a study investigating factors contributing to body appreciation in emerging adult women. The study involved 387 women aged 18-25 who completed self-report questionnaires. It explored the impact of early memories, self-compassion, and social safeness on body appreciation and disordered eating attitudes.
